typeClassification: The official boundary dataset has no residential/industrial land-use category. All units retain the neutral type Neighbourhood; no land-use classification is inferred.
geometryProcessing: WGS84 -> UTM zone 12N (EPSG:32612). Topology-preserving simplification: neighbourhoods 2m, roads 3m, water 2m. WGS84 output snapped to a 1e-6 degree precision grid using GEOS valid_output mode, then serialized to 6 decimal places. Invalid polygon inputs repaired with GEOS make_valid; all output polygons verified valid.
anchorMethod: Projected area centroid when strictly inside final polygon; otherwise GEOS representative point. Every final anchor verified strictly inside its rounded output polygon. Display locations are not household positions.
cartographicVintageNote: This is the historical boundary dataset linked by the City 2021 census metadata. The City custom census tabulation was acquired in 2023 and groups some small industrial/river-valley areas with nearby neighbourhoods; statistics are joined by official neighbourhood code and are not redistributed across these polygons. Roads and named hydrology are a separately downloaded current cartographic reference, not census inputs.
licenseAttribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Edmonton.
runtimeNetwork: None required for map geometry: all GeoJSON is self-hosted with the application.
